caption: The drawing depicts a metal cross with a central circle intersecting both the vertical and horizontal arms, colored in dark shades of gray and black. Each end of the cross is adorned with a pointed, spear-like fleur-de-lis finial, with small curled extensions on either side of the three tips. To the lower left, there is a detailed enlargement of one of these finials, labeled as "¼ ACTUAL SIZE." On the right margin, a thin, upright outline indicates a side view of the cross, drawn in simple black line with minimal detail, revealing the profile of the structure. The background is a plain off-white color. The main cross is presented with the notation "SCALE: 1½" = 1'-0" beneath it.
title: Cross
